svg.title: LeilMat
svg.desc: Sibling to leil.xyz/favicon.svg. Same 554x462 viewBox and dot positions/radii so the LeilMat icon reads as part of the Leil family at 16x16 in a browser tab. The dot palette uses three tones of warm gold drawn from the LeilMat brand accent hsl(38 96% 60%): primary #f7af41, lighter #fbcb86, deeper anchor #cc8633.
